name: fda-approval-catalyst-pipeline
description: FDA approval catalyst pipeline. For each ticker, correlates recent openFDA regulatory wins (drug approvals, device PMA approvals, 510(k) clearances) with insider open-market buying in a window around the decision date, scores conviction 0-100, and tiers each as approval_confirmed / accumulation / watch. Public openFDA + EDGAR data, no browser, no API keys.
